question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Microsoft)

calls.reasoning: Microsoft guided fiscal Q1 2027 revenue (Jul-Sep 2026) to $89.85-90.95B, which is 16-17% growth on about $77.7B a year ago. Over the last four quarters it beat the TOP of guidance by about $1.9B (Q1 FY26), $0.7B (Q2), about $1.2B (Q3) and $2.2B (Q4: $90.0B actual vs a guided $86.7-87.8B). The anchor is the top of guidance plus the mean beat of about $1.3-1.5B, so about $92.1-92.4B. The dollar stayed close to its July level through September (EUR/USD 1.14), so FX should be roughly neutral against the guidance assumption. Consensus is about $90.6-90.7B, but sell-side numbers usually sit at the top of guidance and Microsoft beats them. Escape below $90.2B would need a miss of the guidance range, which has not happened recently. Escape above $94.5B would need a beat of more than $3.5B, about 1.6x the largest recent beat. No market matching this contract was found. Polymarket has only a 'beat estimates' market (reported ~95% in July) plus Kalshi mention markets, which is a different contract and so not an anchor.
calls.dossier:
- Microsoft FY27 Q1 (quarter ended Sep 30, 2026) guidance given Jul 29, 2026: total revenue $89.85-90.95B, 16-17% YoY growth. Azure guided to +45% in constant currency. Windows OEM/devices guided to decline in the low 20s %. New two-segment reporting ('Agents and Infra' / 'Devices and Consumer') starts in FY27 (CNBC/Investing.com, Jul 29 2026).
- Year-ago quarter FY26 Q1 revenue: about $77.7B (MSFT IR).
- FY26 Q4 (Jun 2026): revenue $90.0B, +18% (+17% cc). Guidance had been $86.7-87.8B, so it beat the top by about $2.2B (Microsoft Source, Jul 29 2026; Yahoo/QZ for the guidance).
- FY26 Q3 (Mar 2026): revenue $82.9B vs $81.39B consensus; guidance top about $81.75B (Yahoo Finance, Apr 29 2026).
- FY26 Q2: about $81.3B vs a guided $79.5-80.6B. FY26 Q1: about $77.7B vs a guided $74.65-75.75B (MSFT IR, from memory of past releases).
- Beat over the top of guidance across the last 4 quarters: about +$1.9B, +$0.7B, +$1.2B, +$2.2B.
- Sell-side consensus for FY27 Q1 sits near the top of guidance, about $90.6-90.7B (MarketBeat, TIKR, Oct 2026).
- Report expected Oct 27-28, 2026 (MarketBeat says Oct 28).
- FX: DXY up about 3% YoY in late Sep 2026. EUR/USD about 1.14 on Sep 25, nearly the same as its July level, so roughly flat against the guidance-time FX assumption (CNBC, Sep 30 2026).
- Stock up about 39% since Jun 30, 2026 (TIKR).
- Status quo: the outcome lands inside or above the guidance range. No guidance miss in recent years.
- Resolution: resolves off Microsoft's reported total revenue for the Jul-Sep 2026 quarter, not segment revenue or Microsoft Cloud revenue.
- Event window: the first revenue report after Sep 2026, expected Oct 27-28, 2026. As of Oct 11, before the release.
- Searched without finding: a market on the revenue number itself (none found), and any mid-quarter guidance update.

calls.reasoning: Microsoft guided revenue for the quarter ended Sep 30, 2026 to $89.85-90.95B (midpoint $90.4B). Actual revenue beat the guidance midpoint by about 2.1%, 1.5%, 2.1% and 3.2% in the last four quarters, a mean of about 2.2%, which implies about $92.4B. Currency is roughly neutral against the July assumptions (EUR/USD about 1.14 in both July and late September). Azure is guided to speed up to 45% in constant currency, offset by a weak Windows/devices business. Median $92.3B. Tails: a result below guidance (under $90.2B) about 1.5%; a beat of more than 4.5% (over $94.5B) about 2.5%. No human prediction market on the revenue figure was found.
calls.reconciliation: In dispute: (1) the guidance for the Sep 2025 quarter. Run 1 had 74.65-75.75; Runs 2 and 3 had 75.5-76.6 or a similar midpoint. I side with 75.5-76.6 from recall of the Jul 2025 release, which makes that quarter's beat about 2.1%, not 3.3%. This could not be web-verified on this run. (2) The mean beat size. Run 2's 2.8% includes FY25 beats that are uncertain and larger, plus the overstated Sep 2025 figure. The four FY26 quarters with more reliable figures average about 2.2%, which places the median near $92.3-92.4B, between Run 2 and Runs 1/3, because of the evidence and not by averaging. (3) FX: Run 1's evidence shows EUR/USD flat from July to September, so I treat it as neutral. (4) Tail masses are a judgment call: no recent result below guidance; the largest recent beat is 3.2%, so a beat above 4.5% gets a small but non-zero weight because Azure growth is speeding up. Dispersion: I adopt a width close to Runs 1 and 2.
